name: SpeechParaling-Bench-Baseline-Doubao
description: A collection from the SpeechParaling benchmark family providing baseline paralinguistic speech tasks (e.g., emotion/attribute recognition) for the Doubao subset. It measures models' ability to predict paralinguistic labels from audio samples and is intended for benchmarking standard speech-paralinguistic classification methods.
evaluation_method: F1 (often reported as macro-F1 or UAR)
reputation: Moderately used within the speech-paralinguistics research community as a baseline collection with established baselines.
